reason: My team already rate-limits every key and could build caps, an approval queue and a kill switch for agent accounts inside a quarter, and no regulator is asking me for this yet. I don't buy what I can build, especially not something that sits in my order path.
objection: Putting a pre-revenue startup with no customers and no SOC 2 as a proxy in front of every customer trade is a latency, uptime and vendor-risk problem I'd have to defend to my own compliance people, for a requirement that doesn't exist yet.
would_change_my_mind: FINRA or the SEC making agent identity checks and decision evidence an explicit exam expectation, so the passport verification and export formats become something I can't credibly build and keep current myself.
